name: Liminal Space Visual Novel
source:
A liminal space is a place between worlds. Where time becomes distorted, and reality becomes bended. Explore the ever-changing liminal reality as you adventure throughout time itself. And see a location that has been forgotten and trapped in time, and feel forgotten memories from a not-so-distant place. Welcome now to your journey throughout the liminal space... Become lost in time.

[From in-game description]
